definitions.full: H8161. shaatah [ שַׁעֲטָה ] noun feminine stamping (of hoofs); — construct אַבִּירָיו מַּרְסוֺת שַׁעֲטַת Jer 47:3 .
definitions.rootNote: feminine from an unused root meaning to stamp ;
